cohort: Women who delivered between 2005 and mid-2010 in the Emilia-Romagna Region of Italy
finding: Clinical variables, particularly previous cesarean delivery, mal-position/mal-presentation, fetal distress, and abruptio placentae or placenta previa or ante-partum hemorrhage, are strong predictors of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Clinical variables, such as previous cesarean section, malpresentation, fetal distress, and placental abruption, were significant predictors of cesarean delivery.
